title: Bones on religion: humans and aliens part of the same creation
summary: Dan Sherman tells of Bones on religion: humans and aliens part of the same creation, about early 1990s at Base 2, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: he mentioned that the that we are part of the same creation.

plain: Dan Sherman is a former Air Force sergeant who says a US intelligence agency hired him to communicate with aliens. He told a podcast host, Jesse Michels, that in the early 1990s, at a place he calls Base 2, a being he calls Bones talked about religion and said that humans and aliens are part of the same creation. If true, it would mean the beings themselves see us as made by the same hand.
